features.title: Trusted inline hosts and agents
features.expect: Real fleet payload reaches the kit; Source and per-host notes are visible; Refresh re-calls glide.fleet in the same panel

features.title: Portfolio task cards
features.expect: Optional portfolio key reaches glide.fleet; Task URLs open safely; Set next drafts without sending

features.title: Factory graph and fixes
features.expect: Graph uses the existing inline kit renderer; SVG nodes have native click controls; Queue fix drafts without sending; Other factory commands retain their existing path

features.title: Resume trusted Hermes sessions
features.expect: Hermes agent ids resume sessions; Process ids and other harnesses produce a visible note

features.title: Read-only pod descriptions
features.expect: glide.fleet_pod returns text to a transcript panel; Late replies cannot appear in a replacement session

features.title: Owner-scoped fleet actions
features.expect: Only fixed action ids route; Unknown or invalid actions produce a note; Stale native callbacks are inert; Model fences cannot grant host authority
